create_hmm_model: create a Hidden Markov Model with init_dist, trans_dist, and obs_dist categorical distributions
sample_hmm_sequences: sample hidden state and observation sequences from an HMM given a PRNG seed and sequence length
run_forward_algorithm: run the forward algorithm on an observation sequence to compute belief states and log-likelihood
run_backward_algorithm: run the backward algorithm on an observation sequence to compute backward joint probabilities
run_viterbi_algorithm: run the Viterbi algorithm on an observation sequence to find the most probable hidden state sequence
